{
  "subtype": "faceted_decomposition",
  "concept": "food_quality",
  "per_column": [
    {"name": "facet_taste_flavor", "is_constitutive_facet": true, "role": "facet", "rationale": "Taste/flavor is a core intrinsic aspect of food quality."},
    {"name": "facet_texture", "is_constitutive_facet": true, "role": "facet", "rationale": "Mouthfeel/texture is a constitutive sensory aspect of food quality."},
    {"name": "facet_freshness", "is_constitutive_facet": true, "role": "facet", "rationale": "Freshness is an intrinsic quality dimension of the food itself."},
    {"name": "facet_packaging", "is_constitutive_facet": false, "role": "external_predictor", "rationale": "Packaging is a property of the product presentation, not an aspect of the food's quality itself; it can influence perception but is external to the food."},
    {"name": "facet_value_price", "is_constitutive_facet": false, "role": "external_predictor", "rationale": "Price/value is an economic attribute distinct from the food's intrinsic quality, not a part-of quality."},
    {"name": "facet_health_nutrition", "is_constitutive_facet": true, "role": "facet", "rationale": "Nutritional/health properties are a legitimate intrinsic dimension of food quality."},
    {"name": "facet_product_variety", "is_constitutive_facet": false, "role": "external_predictor", "rationale": "Variety of product offerings is an assortment attribute, not a facet of the quality of a given food."},
    {"name": "facet_consistency_reliability", "is_constitutive_facet": true, "role": "facet", "rationale": "Consistency of quality across purchases is a defensible quality dimension, though it partly overlaps with freshness/reliability."},
    {"name": "facet_comparison_brand", "is_constitutive_facet": false, "role": "irrelevant", "rationale": "Comparison to other brands is a rhetorical/relational move in a review, not a constitutive aspect of food quality."},
    {"name": "facet_delivery_service", "is_constitutive_facet": false, "role": "external_predictor", "rationale": "Delivery/service concerns the transaction and logistics, entirely external to the food's quality."}
  ],
  "facet_columns": ["facet_taste_flavor", "facet_texture", "facet_freshness", "facet_health_nutrition", "facet_consistency_reliability"],
  "non_facet_columns": ["facet_packaging", "facet_value_price", "facet_product_variety", "facet_comparison_brand", "facet_delivery_service"],
  "mutual_exclusivity": 0.6,
  "exhaustiveness": 0.7,
  "rationale": "Half of the added columns are genuine constitutive facets of food quality (taste/flavor, texture, freshness, health/nutrition, and arguably consistency), carving the sensory and intrinsic dimensions well and fairly exhaustively. However, the set is diluted by several external attributes that are not meronymic parts of food quality: packaging, value/price, product variety, brand comparison, and delivery/service belong to the broader consumer-experience or transactional space, not the food-quality concept itself. Mutual exclusivity is moderately weakened by overlap between consistency/reliability and freshness, and exhaustiveness is reduced because the presence of non-facets shows the decomposition targets the whole review experience rather than the quality concept alone."
}
